qs.q: If $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ are the roots of $3x^{3}-6x^{2}+x-9=0$, find $\lambda=\dfrac{171(\alpha+\beta)(\beta+\gamma)(\gamma+\alpha)}{(\alpha\beta+3)(\beta\gamma+3)(\gamma\alpha+3)}$.
Find the number of real values of $a$ for which both roots of $x^{2}-(a-2)x-(a+23)=0$ are integers.
Both roots of $x^{2}+bx+b=0$ satisfy $x^{3}+3x^{2}+3x+2=0$. Find the sum of all possible values of $b$.
Let $A=\left\{a\in\mathbb R:\ a\left(x^{2}-x+1\right)>x^{2}-x-1\ \text{ for all } x\in\mathbb R\right\}$. Find the least element of $A$.
Let $R(x)$ be the remainder when $x^{31}-2x^{21}+3x^{11}-x^{5}+7$ is divided by $x^{3}+1$. Find $R(2)$.

A polynomial $p(x)$ of degree greater than $10$ leaves remainders $1$ and $2$ when divided by $x+1$ and $x-2$ respectively. If $R(x)$ is the remainder when $p(x)$ is divided by $x^{2}-x-2$, find $R(5)$.
The roots $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ of $x^{3}-2x^{2}-11x+a=0$ satisfy $\alpha+2\beta+3\gamma=0$. Find the sum of all possible values of $27a$.
The $20$th, $34$th and $49$th terms of a non-constant arithmetic progression are in geometric progression with common ratio $r$. Find $14r$.
Find the sum of all integers from $1$ to $100$ that are divisible by $2$, $3$ or $5$.
Find the value of $\ 241\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{15}\dfrac{k}{k^{4}+k^{2}+1}$.
Three consecutive terms of a GP have sum $19$ and product $216$; $S_{n}$ is the sum of the first $n$ terms of that GP. Which of the following is/are possible?
If $x,y$ are real numbers with $\dfrac{\cos^{4}x}{\cos^{2}y}+\dfrac{\sin^{4}x}{\sin^{2}y}=1$, find $\lambda=\dfrac{\cos^{6}x}{\cos^{4}y}+\dfrac{\sin^{6}x}{\sin^{4}y}$.
If $\sin x+\sin^{2}x=1$, find $\lambda=\cos^{4}x+3\cos^{6}x+4\cos^{8}x+3\cos^{10}x+\cos^{12}x$.
Which of the following is/are correct, for $x\in\mathbb{R}$?
o: The range of $6\sin x\cos x+6\cos^{2}x+14\sin^{2}x$ is $[5,15]$.
The range of $24\sin x\cos x-7\cos^{2}x+1$ is $[-15,10]$.
The maximum value of $(3\sin x-4\cos x)(4\sin x+3\cos x)$ is $25$.
The difference between the greatest and least values of $(3\sin x-4\cos x)(4\sin x+3\cos x)$ is $25$.

qs.q: If $\alpha,\beta$ are the roots of $x^{2}+2x-4=0$ and \[\lambda=\frac1{\alpha-1}+\frac1{\beta-1}+\frac{2\alpha+3}{\alpha^{2}-5\alpha+6}+\frac{2\beta+3}{\beta^{2}-5\beta+6},\] find $22\lambda$.
Find the sum of all real values of $x$ for which $\dfrac{3x^2-9x+17}{x^2+3x+10}=\dfrac{5x^2-7x+19}{3x^2+5x+12}$.
Let $A=\{a\in\mathbb Z:\ |B_a|=2\}$, where $B_a=\{x\in\mathbb Z:\ x^{2}-(a+1)x+(a-3)=0\}$. Find the sum of the squares of the elements of $A$.
Which of the following is/are correct?
o: The number of integers $n\in[1,100]$ for which $x^{2}+x-n=0$ has integer roots is $9$.
The number of integers $n\in[1,100]$ for which $x^{2}+x-n=0$ has rational roots is greater than $9$.
$x=-1$ is a root of $(a+2)x^{2}+2(a+1)x+a=0$ for every real $a$.
The number of integers $a$ for which every root of $(a+2)x^{2}+2(a+1)x+a=0$ is an integer is $5$.

qs.q: A polynomial $p(x)$ of degree $10$ leaves remainders $1,2$ and $3$ when divided by $x-3,\ x-2$ and $x-1$ respectively. If $R(x)$ is the remainder when $p(x)$ is divided by $x^{3}-6x^{2}+11x-6$, find $R(10)$.

If a rational number $\frac pq$ (in lowest terms) is a root of $a_nx^n+\cdots+a_1x+a_0=0$ with integer coefficients, then $p\mid a_0$ and $q\mid a_n$. Using this, find $\lambda=|\{x\in\mathbb Q:\ 2x^3-3x^2-11x+6=0\}|+|\{x\in\mathbb Q:\ x^{1000}-x^{500}+x^{100}+x+1=0\}|$, where $|S|$ is the number of elements of $S$.
The first three terms of an AP have sum $27$ and sum of squares $293$. Find the sum of all possible values of $a^{2}+d^{2}$, where $a$ is the first term and $d$ the common difference.
$a_{1},a_2,\dots,a_{n}$ are in HP and $\dfrac1{\lambda_{n}}=\dfrac{a_{1}a_{n}}{a_{1}a_{2}+a_{2}a_{3}+\dots+a_{n-1}a_{n}}$. Find $\lambda_{10}+\lambda_{11}+\dots+\lambda_{20}$.
If $\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{40}\sqrt{1+\frac1{k^2}+\frac1{(k+1)^2}}=a+\frac bc$, where $a,b,c\in\mathbb N$, $b\lt c$ and $\gcd(b,c)=1$, find $a+b$.
$\lambda=\displaystyle\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac1{(2n+1)!}$ and $\mu=\displaystyle\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac1{(2n)!}$. Find the integer nearest to $2\lambda e+3\mu e$.
If $[m,M]$ is the range of $f(x)=(3\sin x-4\cos x-10)(3\sin x+4\cos x-10)$, find $M-m$.
Find the value of $16\sin20^\circ\sin40^\circ\sin60^\circ\sin80^\circ$.
Let $x$ vary over all real numbers for which $\tan x$ and $\tan3x$ are defined and $\tan x\ne0$. Find the number of integers that $\dfrac{\tan3x}{\tan x}$ can not take.
Which of the following is/are integers?
The equation $(x+2)(x+3)(x+8)(x+12)=4x^2$ has two rational and two irrational roots. If $S$ is the sum of the irrational roots, find $|S|$.
A monic quadratic $P(x)$ is such that $P(x)=0$ and $P(P(P(x)))=0$ have a common root. Find the value of $P(0)\,P(1)$.
Find the least integer $a$ for which the equation $x^4+(a-1)x^3+x^2+(a-1)x+1=0$ has at least two distinct negative roots.
Which of the following is/are correct?
If $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta$ are the roots of $x^4+x^3+x-2=0$, find $\dfrac{1}{\alpha^2-1}+\dfrac{1}{\beta^2-1}+\dfrac{1}{\gamma^2-1}+\dfrac{1}{\delta^2-1}$.
If $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ are the roots of $x^3-x^2+2x-1=0$, find \[7\left(\frac{\alpha+2}{\alpha^2-3\alpha+2}+\frac{\beta+2}{\beta^2-3\beta+2}+\frac{\gamma+2}{\gamma^2-3\gamma+2}\right).\]
Find the number of distinct real numbers $x$ which satisfy $\dfrac{1}{x-1}+\dfrac{1}{x-2}+\dfrac{1}{x-3}+\cdots+\dfrac{1}{x-10}=0$.

Positive numbers $x,y,z\ne1$ and $a>0$, $a\ne1$, are such that $\frac1{\log_{x}a},\frac1{\log_{y}a},\frac1{\log_{z}a}$ are in GP, $xyz=a^{15}$ and $x^{4}y^{2}z=a^{15}$. Find the common ratio of $\log_{a}x,\log_{a}y,\log_{a}z$.
Find $\lambda$, where $\dfrac1\lambda=\dfrac{100}{\binom{500}{99}}+99\displaystyle\sum_{k=101}^{500}\dfrac1{\binom k{100}}$.
Let $a$ and $b$ be positive integers. The value of $xyz$ is $55$ or $\dfrac{343}{55}$ according as $a,x,y,z,b$ are in arithmetic progression or in harmonic progression. Find $a^2+b^2$.

$a\in\mathbb R$ and $f$ is a polynomial with $a+\dfrac1{f(n)}=\dfrac1{2\cdot5\cdot8}+\dfrac1{5\cdot8\cdot11}+\dfrac1{8\cdot11\cdot14}+\cdots$ ($n$ terms) for all $n\in\mathbb N$. Which of the following is/are correct?
Find the value of $\dfrac{\sin^22\theta}{\cos^2\theta}+\dfrac{\sin^24\theta}{\cos^22\theta}+\dfrac{\sin^28\theta}{\cos^24\theta}$, where $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{7}$.
If the equation $3\sin x+4\cos(c+x)+4\cos(c-x)=5$ has a real solution $x$, find the minimum value of $4|\cos c|$.
Find the value of $\sec\dfrac{2\pi}{5}+\sec\dfrac{4\pi}{5}$.
If $\cos\theta=-\dfrac12$ and $\pi\lt\theta\lt\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$, find $4\tan^{2}\theta-3\operatorname{cosec}^{2}\theta$.
If $x^4+ax^3+2x^2+bx+1=0$ $(a,b\in\mathbb{R})$ has at least one real root, find the minimum value of $a^2+b^2$.

If $\alpha,\beta$ are the roots of $x^{2}+2x-1=0$ and $\gamma,\delta$ those of $x^{2}-x+2=0$, find \[\lambda=\left(\alpha^{2}-\gamma^{3}\right)\left(\alpha^{2}-\delta^{3}\right)\left(\beta^{2}-\gamma^{3}\right)\left(\beta^{2}-\delta^{3}\right).\]
Let $B=\{x\in\mathbb R:\ 2x^{2}+3x-4=0\}$ and $C_{a}=\{x\in\mathbb R:\ x^{2}+2x-a=0\}$. Which of the following is/are correct?
o: The sum of all $a$ with $B\cap C_{a}\ne\emptyset$ is $\frac{13}{4}$.

qs.q: Consider $x^{2}+2(a-3)x+9=0$. Which of the following is/are correct?
o: Both roots lie in $(-6,1)$ if and only if $a\in\left[6,\frac{27}4\right)$.
Both roots lie in $[-6,1)$ if and only if $a\in\left[6,\frac{27}4\right]$.
Both roots lie in $(-6,1]$ if and only if $a\in\left[6,\frac{27}4\right)$.
Both roots lie in $[-6,1]$ if and only if $a\in\left[6,\frac{27}4\right)$.

qs.q: If $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ are the roots of $x^3-x^2+2x-3=0$, find \[\lambda=\frac{\alpha^8\left(\alpha^2+2\right)+\beta^8\left(\beta^2+2\right)+\gamma^8\left(\gamma^2+2\right)}{\alpha^7\left(\alpha^2+3\right)+\beta^7\left(\beta^2+3\right)+\gamma^7\left(\gamma^2+3\right)}.\]
If $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ are the roots of $x^3-x^2+2x-3=0$ and $a_n=\dfrac{\alpha^n+2\beta^n+3\gamma^n}{4}$, find $\lambda=\dfrac{a_{100}-a_{99}+2a_{98}}{a_{97}}$.
Let $R(x)$ be the remainder when $f(x)=1+x+x^{12}+x^{123}+x^{1234}+\cdots+x^{123456789}$ is divided by $1+x+x^2+\cdots+x^9$. Find $R(2)$.

$f$ and $g$ are polynomials with $f(n)=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left(4k^{2}-1\right)(2k+3)$ and $g(n)=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left(9k^{2}+24k+7\right)(3k+4)$ for all $n\in\mathbb N$. Find $\lambda$, where \[\frac\lambda3=\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(\frac{f(n)}{n^{4}}+2f\left(\tfrac1n\right)-3g\left(\tfrac1n\right)+\frac{4g(n)}{n^{4}}\right).\]
Find the greatest integer not exceeding $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{1599}\frac1{\sqrt n}$.
Let $a,b$ be integers with $0\lt a\lt b\lt 10^6$ such that the arithmetic mean of $a$ and $b$ is exactly $8$ more than their geometric mean. Find the number of ordered pairs $(a,b)$.
Five distinct $2$-digit numbers are in a geometric progression. Find the middle term.
If $\sin 1^\circ\sin 3^\circ\sin 5^\circ\cdots\sin 89^\circ=\dfrac{1}{2^n}$, find $2n$.
Find the value of $\dfrac{1}{\cos\frac{\pi}{9}\cos\frac{2\pi}{9}\cos\frac{4\pi}{9}}$.
Find $(1-\tan1^\circ)(1-\tan2^\circ)(1-\tan3^\circ)(1+\tan46^\circ)(1+\tan47^\circ)(1+\tan48^\circ)$.
Evaluate $\cos10^\circ+\cos20^\circ+\cos30^\circ+\cdots+\cos170^\circ$.
